references.text: Here Aaron's and Moses' rebellion at the waters of Meribah is explained, which is the reason they are not allowed to enter the Promised Land.
Describes Aaron's death on Mount Hor, fulfilling what was predicted in verse 24.
Moses receives the same judgment as Aaron – he will be gathered to his people because of the rebellion at the waters of Meribah.
Retells Aaron's death on Mount Hor in the fortieth year after the departure from Egypt.
The expression 'gathered to his people' is first used concerning Abraham, and denotes death and reunion with the ancestors.
Jacob was gathered to his people at his death, using the same expression as is used for Aaron.
Moses will die on the mountain and be gathered to his people, just as Aaron died on Mount Hor, because of their unfaithfulness at Meribah.
The entire passage concerning Moses' impending death refers back to the rebellion at Meribah and Aaron's fate.
